waivers.reason: The frame draws tile 13 frozen mid-press (scaled 1.04 x 0.94); the app shows the tapped tile at rest with its focus ring, as the S8 spec says. A press squash cannot be held after the finger lifts, and bounds never see transforms. A pre-listed design-artefact pair of the parity skill.
